# ukdatakit

> ukdatakit makes pay-per-result tools for official UK public data, available on the Apify Store. Results export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or by API. Pricing is per result and shown on Apify. Apify profile: https://apify.com/ukdatakit

## Tools

- [UK House Prices](https://ukdatakit.com/#uk-house-prices): sold house prices from HM Land Registry Price Paid Data by full postcode, sector or outcode, with date filters and a run summary including the median price. One row per sale: price, date, full address, postcode, property type, new build, tenure, transaction category and a link to the Land Registry record. On Apify: https://apify.com/ukdatakit/uk-house-prices
- [UK Visa Sponsor Register](https://ukdatakit.com/#uk-visa-sponsor-register): search the Home Office register of licensed sponsors by organisation name, town and route; check whether an employer can sponsor Skilled Worker visas. One row per sponsor: name, town, county, routes, types and ratings, Skilled Worker flag, register date and a link to the GOV.UK CSV. Also has a change monitor mode for sponsors added to or removed from the register. On Apify: https://apify.com/ukdatakit/uk-visa-sponsor-register
- [UK Planning Constraints Checker](https://ukdatakit.com/#uk-planning-constraints): bulk-check postcodes or coordinates in England for conservation areas, listed buildings (and nearby listed buildings with grade and distance), Article 4 directions, tree preservation orders, flood zone 2/3, green belt, national parks, National Landscapes, SSSIs, scheduled monuments and World Heritage Sites. Flags when a council has not published a layer. Source: planning.data.gov.uk (OGL). On Apify: https://apify.com/ukdatakit/uk-planning-constraints
- [Companies House ID Verification Checker](https://ukdatakit.com/#uk-companies-house-id-verification): check which directors and PSCs have verified their identity under ECCTA, with due dates per person. Source: Companies House public data API. On Apify: https://apify.com/ukdatakit/uk-companies-house-id-verification
- [UK Food Business Leads](https://ukdatakit.com/#uk-food-business-leads): restaurants, cafés, takeaways, pubs and food shops by UK council or postcode district from Food Standards Agency hygiene rating data, matched to the limited company on Companies House (with high/medium/possible confidence). Finds new openings (awaiting first inspection), low ratings and limited companies, with a weekly monitor and a PECR corporate-subscriber flag. Source: FSA FHRS and Companies House (OGL). On Apify: https://apify.com/ukdatakit/uk-food-business-leads
- [UK School Jobs & Hiring Schools](https://ukdatakit.com/uk-teaching-vacancies): every live job on Teaching Vacancies, the Department for Education’s national job site for schools in England, including teachers, teaching assistants, SENCOs, heads and support staff. Filter by keyword, region, town, postcode, category, working pattern, salary and dates, or switch to one row per hiring school. Schedule a feed of jobs not seen in earlier runs. Source: Teaching Vacancies API (OGL). Schools in England only. On Apify: https://apify.com/ukdatakit/uk-teaching-vacancies
- [UK Company Accounts](https://ukdatakit.com/uk-company-accounts): financial figures from UK company accounts filed electronically with Companies House: turnover, gross and operating profit, profit after tax, cash, debtors, stock, net assets, equity and average employees, with last year’s values and turnover growth. Filter by company number, name, turnover, cash, profit or headcount. Source: Companies House Accounts Data Product. This tool is not affiliated with or endorsed by Companies House. No director names or other personal details. On Apify: https://apify.com/ukdatakit/uk-company-accounts
- [UK Waste Carrier Licence Check](https://ukdatakit.com/uk-waste-carriers-register): check a waste carrier licence on the Environment Agency register for England by registration number, business name or postcode, or list new registrations and upper-tier licences due to expire. Not-found checks are free. Sole traders are left out of lead lists by default. England only. Source: Environment Agency public register. If you republish the data, keep the attribution: Contains Environment Agency information © Environment Agency and/or database right. On Apify: https://apify.com/ukdatakit/uk-waste-carriers-register
- [UK Nurseries & Childcare](https://ukdatakit.com/uk-nurseries-childcare): registered nurseries, pre-schools and out-of-school clubs in England, with Ofsted URN, setting type, address, council, registered places, the latest Ofsted rating or new report-card grades, and a link to the report. Filter by area, size, rating and registration date to find new settings. The latest Ofsted file covered about 60,000 providers as at 30 June 2026. Childminders are redacted by Ofsted and are never returned. Source: Ofsted (OGL). England only. On Apify: https://apify.com/ukdatakit/uk-nurseries-childcare
- [UK Government Consultations Tracker](https://ukdatakit.com/uk-gov-consultations): open, closed and outcome-published UK government consultations and calls for evidence on GOV.UK, with days left to respond. Filter by keyword or department and schedule a watchlist for new consultations and published responses. The default input returns consultations open right now (about 60–80 at a time). Covers UK government departments and agencies that publish on GOV.UK, not most devolved-government consultations. Source: GOV.UK search API (OGL). On Apify: https://apify.com/ukdatakit/uk-gov-consultations

## Other

- [Custom data jobs](https://ukdatakit.com/#custom): tailored feeds from official UK open data. Contact vora+ukdatakit@mail.grokbot.com.
- Data licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (Crown copyright) for most sources. Waste carrier data is under the Environment Agency conditional licence and needs the Environment Agency attribution.
